description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Balasooriyage Samantha Indika Dayasundara as a member of the Dompe P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Dompe Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
